title: 달빛 박물관 잠입 수사
description: 문 닫은 달빛 박물관에 잠입한 고양이 탐정단과 함께 전시실의 다섯 가지 단서를 찾아보세요.
theme: 고양이 탐정단의 달빛 박물관 잠입 수사
scene: A whimsical grand museum gallery after closing time, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. Tall moonlit arched windows and warm brass wall lamps create a cozy midnight mystery atmosphere. At the lower-left, one friendly orange tabby detective cat in a navy cape and cream deerstalker hat crouches beside a velvet rope; the hat has exactly one large upright teal feather. On the upper-left wall, one prominent sapphire-blue heraldic shield displays exactly one large gold crescent emblem at its center. At center, a broad cream stone pedestal supports a glass display case containing exactly four large ruby-red gemstones arranged in one clearly separated row. At the upper-right, one charming bronze owl statue on a wall shelf wears exactly one small purple top hat. In the lower-right foreground, a friendly gray mouse assistant carries one burgundy evidence suitcase with exactly one large gold diamond-shaped clasp centered on its front. Add a marble floor with soft reflections, plain framed landscape paintings without text, dinosaur bones in the far background, a potted fern, rolled blank maps, a brass telescope, velvet curtains, and a sleeping museum guard dog only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the teal feather, gold crescent shield emblem, four red gemstones, purple owl top hat, and gold diamond suitcase clasp large, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, or numbers.
